system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Animal Handling and Medicine, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Animal Anatomy Lore, Livestock Diseases Lore, Stable Management Lore.
system.description: You tended injured mounts and sick livestock, working with patients who could neither explain their pain nor promise to stay still. A calm approach became as useful to you as a steady hand.
